question: Kalbelia dance, also known as the 'Sapera Dance', is the folk dance of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kalbelia dance, also known as the 'Sapera Dance', is a traditional folk dance of the Kalbelia community.
 
• The dance is associated with the Kalbelia community, traditionally known as snake charmers.
 
• In 2010, Kalbelia dance was inscribed on UNESCO’s list of Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
 
• Kalbelia dance is accompanied by folk music played on traditional instruments, including the morsing, dholak, and shehnai.
